grading: Correct only if every requested material fact resolved, no contradiction or unsupported guess. Partial for missing/unresolved parts, incorrect for any material contradiction. Judge content rather than support label.

answers.answer: Invaders do 3 Damage simultaneously to land and Dahan, adding one Blight, killing one Dahan and damaging the other by 1. The surviving Dahan still deals 2 Damage, destroying the Town and generating 1 Fear. Dahan do not absorb/prevent land damage; partial Dahan damage clears at Time Passes.

Move the eighth marker to earn the top Fear card face-down, reset all 8 to the pool and put the remaining 2 generated Fear toward the next card. Terror II applies as soon as exposed (subject to outcome check at action-tree end). Keep card hidden until Fear step, resolving in earned order at the then-current Terror level only.

Destroy one Presence each of A and B, putting destroyed disks beside the island, not on tracks. Add the original Blight and cascade one additional Blight to one adjacent land, not all. If that land already has Blight it too loses one Presence per Spirit there and cascades again. Existing amount of Blight does not multiply the one cascade.

Damage normally means to Invaders only, distributed as chosen in target land; can combine within turn, immediately destroying pieces at Damage >= Health. Destroying Town/City produces 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear. Remove/Replace generate none automatically; Replace retains prior Damage and may cause destruction if Damage meets new Health (then destruction Fear applies). Surviving Damage clears at Time Passes. Dahan are harmed by Powers only if explicitly stated. An outright Destroy instruction eliminates its specified piece regardless of its Damage or Health. Remove likewise takes the specified piece off the board without requiring Damage to reach Health. Replace removes the original and puts the specified replacement in its place.

answers.answer: Cascade remains part of original single-land Ravage action tree, not a separate outcome-check boundary. Players choose land order and may win at the end of one complete Ravage tree before another land Ravages and could cause loss.

Defend 6 stays in original land and Defend 2 reaches each destination (2 per Dahan Pushed by this Power), independent of other Dahan there. Later unrelated movement does not carry Defend. Additional Defend boosts in original land stay there.

Fear earned immediately on destruction: 1 for Town and 2 for City. Drowned Invaders go on Ocean panel for later trade. Trade X printed Health for 1 Energy, X=Spirits, so in two-Spirit game City gives 1 Energy plus 1 Health change. Ignore Health modifiers; Dahan drown with no Energy benefit.

Separate Powers do not combine hypothetical Damage and each does nothing to undamaged City. Single Power’s instructions combine to would-destroy City and earn 5 Fear, leaving City actually unchanged. Repeat is separate action and can pretend-destroy same piece again if its own Damage suffices; cannot combine its hypothetical Damage with original.
Each hypothetical destruction earns 5 Fear, 10 total. City survives with its original 2 real Damage; Bringer neither marks new Damage nor clears real Damage. Repeat can affect same City again.

For a land-targeting Power, measure the internal arrow from the target land unless otherwise specified. For a Spirit-targeting Power, normally measure from the Presence of the Spirit following the instruction, B here, unless the text says otherwise. Apply the bonuses of the Power user A, not B: the stated Range 1 becomes Range 3 from B’s Presence. Blazing Renewal explicitly measures from the Power user A’s Presence, even when B adds Presence; its explicit origin overrides the default.
The normal Power adds Defend 1, not 2: its printed Fear counts but ordinary Town-destruction Fear does not. The 2 Fear from To Dream a Thousand Deaths does count and adds Defend 2.

answers.answer: Its instruction says to Push the Explorers to as many different lands as possible. With three Explorers and three legal lands, use all three destinations. With only two legal lands, use both, putting the remaining Explorer in one of them.
